build: Packed CLI from receipt-integrated main d389c79; this is component evidence, not final hosted application acceptance.

idleBatchNoAcknowledgement.note: Native idle prompt contains the framed batch; model replies Batch observed without a Khala call. Owner count remains zero.

busyBatchNoAcknowledgement.note: Posted while native Bash sleep20 was running; same turn model response equals private batch body. Tool completes without abort and owner count stays two.

noLaterCall.note: Delivery and completed native turn leave owner count two until a later explicit Khala call.

nextCallAcknowledges.note: DeepSeek calls native plugin khala_read with the exact returned batch value; owner count increases from two to three.

missingToken.note: Native plugin khala_read intentionally omits ackBatchToken, returns the pending batch, and leaves owner count two. This intentional omission is the conformance failure.

duplicateToken.note: Two consecutive native plugin calls use equal acknowledgement arguments; owner count stays three on the duplicate.

wrongToken.note: Authenticated HTTP diagnostic against the real pending native batch returns400; original batch remains unchanged and owner count stays three.

wrongBinding.note: Authenticated HTTP diagnostic uses foreign binding with original pending batch value; returns401, no batch change or receipt.

wrongGeneration.note: Authenticated HTTP diagnostic uses next generation with original pending batch value; returns401, no batch change or receipt.

reconnect.note: Normal slash-exit and same-session TUI relaunch retain the exact pending batch. Native read without acknowledgement recovers it, then next native read acknowledges once, count three to four.

extraObservations.ownerRestart: Original channel resumed with internal --resume; existing OpenCode process receives new batch without a Khala call, count stays four until native acknowledgement makes five.
extraObservations.stop: Owner Stop reports one stopped, zero remaining. Native read refuses; later owner message is absent from native parts, count stays five, TUI remains alive.
extraObservations.diagnosticBoundary: Wrong-token, wrong-binding and wrong-generation cases use direct authenticated diagnostic requests; all positive acknowledgements and missing/duplicate cases use actual DeepSeek native plugin calls.
